facts.fact: ANEC's director general Matar Ndao said in September 2026 that 77% of Senegal's 629 civil registry centres had been digitised; the document does not say what a digitised centre does.
As of August 2026 the civil registry management software had been deployed in 74% of civil registry centres (of 629), a share deployed rather than a share registering, per Ecofin reporting ANEC.

The National Civil Registry Agency (ANEC), a state agency, rolls out the civil registry management software and plans to extend it to the remaining regions; the data are hosted in Senegal on several government-owned sites.
The share of the 629 centres digitised reached 77% in September 2026, with the management software in 74% of centres in August 2026 and extension to the remaining regions planned, per ANEC.
